summary: Spanner adds support for the SAFE_TO_JSON function in GoogleSQL, enabling conversion of SQL objects to JSON while returning JSON null for invalid JSON types instead of raising errors.
extended_definition: Spanner adds support for the SAFE_TO_JSON function in GoogleSQL, enabling conversion of SQL objects to JSON while returning JSON null for invalid JSON types instead of raising errors.
